svg.aria-description: Release pipeline: 9 nodes, 13 connections. 7 jobs and their steps of the Release pipeline workflow, started by a push to main or a manual run, in the order their needs set, imported from GitHub Actions.
svg.font-family: pw-sans-1nuua3rscn2, Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
svg.title: Release pipeline
svg.desc: Release pipeline: 9 nodes, 13 connections. 7 jobs and their steps of the Release pipeline workflow, started by a push to main or a manual run, in the order their needs set, imported from GitHub Actions. Nodes: - Push or manual run, terminal - CI and CD: What to release (ubuntu-latest) - Checkout, step - scripts/next-version.sh | tee -a, step - CI and CD: Tag the beta (ubuntu-latest) - Checkout, step - CI and CD: Release the beta (Calls release.yml) - Release the beta (Calls release.yml), step - CI and CD: Smoke test on preview (Calls smoke.yml) - Smoke test on preview (Calls smoke.yml), step - CI and CD: Tag the stable version (ubuntu-latest) - Checkout, step - CI and CD: Release the stable version (Calls release.yml) - Release the stable version (Calls release.yml), step - Environment: Smoke test on production (Calls smoke.yml) - Smoke test on production (Calls smoke.yml), step Connections: - Push or manual run to Checkout - Checkout to scripts/next-version.sh | tee -a - scripts/next-version.sh | tee -a to Checkout - scripts/next-version.sh | tee -a to Release the beta - Checkout to Release the beta - scripts/next-version.sh | tee -a to Smoke test on preview - Release the beta to Smoke test on preview - scripts/next-version.sh | tee -a to Checkout - Smoke test on preview to Checkout - scripts/next-version.sh | tee -a to Release the stable version - Checkout to Release the stable version - scripts/next-version.sh | tee -a to Smoke test on production - Release the stable version to Smoke test on production
